Refine woodii top navigation header (#505)

## Summary
- simplify the global woodii top header by replacing the stacked breadcrumb/title/description block with a compact page context and title
- remove the extra notification icon and tighten the remaining action controls into a cleaner header row
- add responsive wrapping so the header remains tidy on smaller screens

## Testing
- cd woodii && npm exec --package=yarn@1.22.22 -- yarn build:dev
- cd woodii && npm exec --package=yarn@1.22.22 -- yarn run eslint src/layouts/components/DefaultLayoutWithVerticalNav.vue -c .eslintrc.js --ext .vue
